_comment: ~/.claude/skills/verify-handoff が読むこのリポジトリ固有の検証定義。CI(.github/workflows/test.yml)のブロッキング項目に対応。実行は MY_HOME_SYSTEM 用の venv を有効化した状態で行う。含める/含めない項目の方針と理由は docs/runbooks/claude_automation.md の「verify.json の方針」を参照。

checks.name: shellcheck
checks.cmd: shellcheck -x MY_HOME_SYSTEM/*.sh MY_HOME_SYSTEM/tools/*.sh MY_HOME_SYSTEM/scripts/*.sh .github/scripts/*.sh family-quest/deploy.sh deploy/git-hooks/post-merge

checks.name: lint-ratchet
checks.cmd: base="$(git merge-base origin/master HEAD)" && python3 .github/scripts/check_lint_ratchet.py --tool ruff --dir MY_HOME_SYSTEM --base "$base" && python3 .github/scripts/check_lint_ratchet.py --tool ruff --dir DDD --base "$base" && python3 .github/scripts/check_lint_ratchet.py --tool bandit --dir MY_HOME_SYSTEM --base "$base" -- -x ./tests -ll -ii && python3 .github/scripts/check_lint_ratchet.py --tool bandit --dir DDD --base "$base" -- -ll -ii
